title: Southern Africa Dedicated Capacity: reservations, localization, and GTM playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Launch Redwood Dedicated capacity in the Southern Africa region (ZA) with 1) localized reservation SKUs and billing in ZAR, 2) support for two new instance types optimized for medium-latency enterprise workloads, and 3) coordinated release notes, console updates, and partner enablement. This ticket is the PM-level orchestration playbook that captures cross-team tasks, timeline, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder owners.

Scope notes: includes API surface parity checks, quota defaults, billing/currency display, console pricing tiles, docs/release notes, Dedicated capacity capacity reservations (commit tiers), telemetry hooks (latency/cost), and compliance checklist for data residency and tax invoicing. Does NOT include on-prem appliance packaging or Marketplace listing work (tracked separately).
acceptance_criteria: ZA region capacity available in Dedicated Console with two new instance SKUs (za-m-4, za-m-8) exposed
Reservation tiers created (monthly/annual) with ZAR pricing and partner discount structures applied
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Docs and Legal, and scheduled for publication on launch date
Console pricing tiles and reservation purchase flow localized to ZAR and tested end-to-end
Billing shows correct tax handling for South Africa (VAT) and invoices include required legal header details
SLOs and telemetry validated: p50/p95 token latency and error rate dashboards for ZA region are reporting
Customer-facing KB and dedicated-runbook for support/solutions engineering published
Cross-team launch checklist items marked Done and post-launch monitoring plan in place
timeline: 2025-01-08: Kickoff with infra, billing, console, docs, legal, sales engineering, and partnerships
2025-01-22: Instance SKU sizing and price engineering sign-off (infra + pricing)
2025-02-05: Console UI mock approved and feature branch opened
2025-02-12: Release notes draft ready for review (Docs + Legal)
2025-02-26: Dry-run reservation purchase test with internal billing account
2025-03-07: Target public launch (soft launch with selected beta customers)
tasks: Infra: provision ZA availability zone + GPU pool, validate kernel profiles for instance SKUs
Billing: add ZAR currency, VAT logic for ZA, invoice header template
Console: add pricing tiles, reservation purchase flow, localized strings
Docs: draft release notes, quickstart for reservations, migration guide from hosted to dedicated
Legal: review and approve reservation terms and billing language
Observability: add ZA region filters to runtime dashboards, alert thresholds for hotspot detection
QA: run cross-env e2e purchase/test with real card and tax calculation validation
Sales: enable partner playbook and partner pricing sheet
Support: publish runbook and triage guide including rollback steps

notes: Risk: VAT/tax complexity and invoice legal language are primary external dependencies. Backup plan: if billing/legal blocks persist, we will launch GA with USD billing and soft-disable reservation purchases for ZA until compliance cleared (customer-facing note required).
post_launch_checks: 48h: monitor p95 latency and error rate for ZA; escalate if errors > 1%
7d: validate reservation uptake and estimate conversion rates vs forecast
30d: review unit economics and update Optimize recommendations for ZA workloads
